summary: Verified HTML export player bug fix for desktop viewports. The issue was that a too-broad CSS media query was hiding header, controls, and progress dots on desktop windows. Fix confirmed working: added max-height: 450px and pointer: coarse conditions to target only real mobile devices in landscape mode.
passed_tests: ✅ HTML export serves correctly with text/html content type
✅ CSS media query fix verified (max-height: 450px present)
✅ CSS touch device fix verified (pointer: coarse present)
✅ All required HTML elements present (#header, #controls, #progress-dots, etc.)
✅ HTML export generation for projects works
✅ Desktop viewport 1920x800: Header visible, Controls visible, Slide visible
✅ Desktop viewport 1024x768: Header visible, Controls visible, Slide visible
✅ Mobile float controls hidden on desktop (display: none)
✅ Course start overlay appears when audio is present

bug_fix_verification.original_issue: HTML export player appearing blank on desktop after 'auto fullscreen' mobile landscape feature was added
bug_fix_verification.root_cause: CSS media query '@media screen and (orientation: landscape) and (max-width: 1024px)' was too broad and affected desktop windows, hiding header, controls, and progress dots
fix_applied: Added max-height: 450px condition to target only true mobile devices in landscape
Added max-width: 950px to further restrict the media query
Added separate media query with 'pointer: coarse' for touch device detection
Fixed FileResponse to return correct MIME type (text/html for .html files, application/zip for .zip files)
evidence: Desktop 1920x800: Header visible=true, Controls visible=true, Slide visible=true
Desktop 1024x768: Header visible=true, Controls visible=true, Slide visible=true
Mobile float controls display=none on desktop (correct)
Playwright UI tests confirmed all elements render correctly

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all UI elements render correctly on desktop viewports)

seed_data_creation: Used existing HTML export file SCORMIFY_20260204_202429.html for testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: HTML export player bug is fixed. The CSS media queries now correctly target only mobile devices in landscape mode using max-height: 450px and pointer: coarse conditions. Desktop viewports (1920x800, 1024x768) display header, controls, and all player elements correctly. FileResponse now returns proper MIME types (text/html for HTML files, application/zip for ZIP files).

new_fixed_queries: @media screen and (orientation: landscape) and (max-width: 950px) and (pointer: coarse)
css_media_query_analysis.why_fix_works: Mobile devices in landscape typically have height < 450px, while desktop windows even when resized maintain higher heights. The pointer: coarse condition also helps identify touch devices.
